questions.markdown:
Seasonal variations in the atmospheric $CO_2$ content can be observed by

1. Studying the Kuznets curve.
2. Studying ice core data.
3. Studying Keeling curve.
4. All the above.

Choose the incorrect statement from the following

1. Income inequality can be decreased by focusing on GDP.
2. Tragedy of the commons is derivative of 'self-interest' for a common resource.
3. Sustainable growth is not equal to Environmental sustainability.
4. Quantity of atmospheric $CO_2$ content is same as that emitted by burning fossil fuels.

Which of the following does not constitute watershed management programme

1. Rehabilitate the deteriorating lands.
2. Decrease infiltration of rainwater.
3. Reduce the effect of sediment yield.
4. Moderate flood

Which one of the following facts is incorrect

1. Eutrophication is observed in agricultural land.
2. Deeper borewells are saline.
3. Weaker monsoon depleted aquifer.
4. A horizon has high organic content.

Hydropower project cannot lead to

1. Siltation of reservoirs
2. Salinity of land
3. Earthquakes
4. None of the above

Which of the following is characterized by stunted trees with canopy density less than ten percent

1. Non forest
2. Open forest
3. Shrub
4. Moderate dense forest

Secondary microplastics are not formed by

1. Thermal degradation of meso plastics
2. Photodegradation
3. Bioremediation
4. Hydrolysis

Non recyclable plastics does not support the following treatment option

1. Energy recovery.
2. Plasma pyrolysis.
3. Coprocessing in cement kiln.
4. Converting waste to oil

Which of the following statement with respect to plastic waste management is not true

1. Nanoplastic leads to bioaccumulation of chemicals
2. Plastics in the surface ocean have a very short lifetime
3. Mesoplastic size range from 2.5cm-5 mm
4. All the above

Which of the following plastic is ideal for curb side recycling programme

1. Polypropylene
2. Polystyrene
3. Polyvinyl chloride
4. All the above
Discuss the socio environmental impacts of green revolution.
Explain the scientific contribution of Charles Keeling towards global warming and its relationship with the carbon dioxide concentration in the atmosphere.
Discuss how lax standards could lead to aggravating air pollution in India.
